decisions.reason: As a very close-to-core service with weak standalone visibility after launch, it likely fell below aspiration as an independent offer and is better absorbed into the established business.
Despite uncertain public visibility, the portal is a strategic digital extension of vessel management and an expanding large firm has enough slack to continue it while learning about customer uptake.
The app is adjacent but more peripheral than the portal, and if uptake has been modest its resources are more valuable in the core service line and in newer development projects.
